reasoning: The claim mischaracterizes the findings of a widely cited March 2023 report by Goldman Sachs. The study did not state that generative AI "will replace" 300 million jobs. Instead, it estimated that generative AI could "expose" the equivalent of 300 million full-time jobs globally to automation. The report explicitly distinguished between exposure and replacement, noting that while about two-thirds of current jobs are exposed to some degree of AI automation, most of these jobs would be complemented rather than substituted by AI. Furthermore, automation historically creates new jobs and industries, meaning exposure to automation does not equate to net job loss.
